description: Department of Agrarian Development - Determination to amend the area of the Authority of Agrarian Service Committee, 19/28 Negampaha Agrarian Service Committee in Galnewa D/S Division, Anuradhapura District published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1132/7 of 16.05.2000
reasoning: This gazette notification deals exclusively with land-related matters, specifically the determination and amendment of areas under the authority of an Agrarian Development Committee. It involves land boundaries, agricultural land divisions, and territorial jurisdiction of agrarian services - all falling under land and property matters as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes). The content does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
